senses.zh_definition: 汉利：英语拼写的姓氏；具体所指须结合人物姓名和上下文确定。
senses.en_definition: Hanley, a surname borne by families of different origins.
senses.ms_definition: Nama keluarga yang dieja Hanley; orang yang dimaksudkan ditentukan melalui konteks.
senses.nuances: 属于 kata nama khas，即专有名词，此处按允许的 noun 类别编码。定义为专名说明，并非 DBP 官方释义；不能从姓氏推断持有人的国籍、族裔或具体家族来源。以下为称谓组合示例。[Woulfe 姓氏记录](https://www.libraryireland.com/names/oh/o-hainle.php)

senses.zh_definition: 汉利：英国英格兰特伦特河畔斯托克的一座组成城镇，也是该市的市中心区域。
senses.en_definition: Hanley, one of the towns forming Stoke-on-Trent, England, and its city centre.
senses.ms_definition: Nama sebuah bandar yang membentuk Stoke-on-Trent di England dan menjadi pusat bandar raya tersebut.
senses.nuances: 地名专用，不能把这个地名义套用于所有同名地点。以下为当地机构名称及地名结构示例，并非马来语固定搭配。[市政府地区说明](https://www.stoke.gov.uk/download/downloads/id/436/city_centre_conservation_area_appraisal.pdf)

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Delegasi itu dijadualkan melawat pusat bandar Hanley semasa lawatan kerja ke Stoke-on-Trent.
dual_scenarios.zh: 代表团计划在赴特伦特河畔斯托克工作访问期间参观汉利市中心。
dual_scenarios.en: The delegation is scheduled to visit Hanley city centre during its working visit to Stoke-on-Trent.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Kau dah sampai kat Hanley ke? Aku nak jumpa kau kat pasar.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Adakah kamu sudah sampai di Hanley? Saya mahu berjumpa dengan kamu di pasar.
dual_scenarios.zh: 你到汉利了吗？我想在市场跟你碰面。
dual_scenarios.en: Have you reached Hanley? I'd like to meet you at the market.

etymology.historical_story: Hanley should be approached as a name rather than a Malay lexical root. Woulfe records Hanley among anglicized forms of the Irish surname Ó hÁinle, associated with a Roscommon family. Separately, Hanley names a town within Stoke-on-Trent. These established uses do not identify the origin of every bearer or explain which occurrence produced the supplied corpus ranking. [Woulfe](https://www.libraryireland.com/names/oh/o-hainle.php); [Stoke-on-Trent City Council](https://www.stoke.gov.uk/download/downloads/id/436/city_centre_conservation_area_appraisal.pdf)
